purpose: Bounded first goal-conditioned +/-15deg yaw pilot after accepted94/100 seven-second grasp and failed frozen-policy rotation readiness

initialize_policy.runtime_environment: ORCA_GRASP_CHECKPOINT points to the same immutable accepted artifact
initialize_policy.transfer: All actor/critic/log_std tensors, fresh optimizer and zero rotation timesteps; resume retains learned rotation weights

protocol.prefix: Actual6.5s empty reach, manual release once,140 deterministic frozen grasp actions; every failed prefix counts as failed rotation episode, no retries
protocol.handoff: No object/hand pose or velocity injection; retain physics time, controller, delays, RNG, camera, history, release-origin geometry/force/displacement audits
protocol.goal: One +/-15deg world-Z target from last measured prefix-end orientation; training balanced random direction, evaluation alternates every seven placement buckets
protocol.success: Full7s continuation; final continuous1s fullSO3<8deg plus loaded opposing thumb/middle pinch, v<.015m/s,w<.3rad/s, orientation span<2deg, position span<2mm; original2ms hard limits retained
protocol.comparisons: Same prefix/initial cases for policy, zero-action hold, random and frozen-grasp continuation; 100-case success>=80%,drops<=10%, policy at least matches hold and frozen-grasp success/drop rates
protocol.scope: Single reorientation subgoal only; no revolution or continuous-rotation acceptance, no hardware deployment
protocol.budget: One200k-step pilot, zero automatic quality extensions or curriculum promotions; inspect failures before another experiment
protocol.seeds: Fresh development2511000..2511027 and formal2611000..2611099, disjoint from prior grasp development/formal blocks
